<thought>Search the template catalog using only the functional group criteria (break aliphatic hydroxyls, form alkyl halide) to obtain the appropriate retrosynthetic template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC=O)c1.FC1CN(Cc2ccc(Cn3nnc(Cl)c3Cl)cc2)C1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkyl halide"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
